hook: Small works and a twelve-artist showcase at Northwind, two comedy nights, and a Turkey Trot on the Larry Scott Trail.

events.title: Next Stop Comedy
events.blurb: An evening of stand-up at the cidery.

events.title: Jumping Mouse Turkey Trot
events.venue: Larry Scott Trail at Haines St
events.address: Boat Haven; park at the Park and Ride by Safeway
events.blurb: A flat, dog- and stroller-friendly 5K and kids' mile raising money for children's mental health care.

events.title: Port Townsend Farmers Market
events.blurb: The Saturday market in Uptown, if the season is still running this late in the year.

events.title: Holiday Art Fair
events.blurb: Handmade gifts from local makers, 10 am to 2:30 pm.

events.title: Comedy Uncorked: Scott Losse Returns
events.blurb: Seattle comic Scott Losse comes back to the bottle shop; it was close to selling out.

events.title: Laurovia Live at Taps
events.venue: Taps at the Guardhouse, Fort Worden
events.blurb: A free two-hour set in the Guardhouse taproom, part of a fourth-Sunday series.

events.title: Small Expressions
events.blurb: A juried show of small works, none bigger than 16 inches, that opens Nov 19 and runs into January.

events.title: Showcase 2026: Round Three
events.blurb: The last round of the year's Showcase: twelve artists in photography, painting, glass, print and mixed media.

events.title: Weekend live music at Finnriver
events.blurb: Live music most weekends; seating is first come, first served.

events.title: Tour the Winter Lights
events.blurb: A self-guided walk or drive past the town's holiday light displays.
